scripts.safari:package: npm run safari:prepare && xcrun safari-web-extension-packager safari/package --project-location safari/generated --app-name ReviewMoa --bundle-identifier kr.reviewmoa.ReviewMoa --swift --ios-only --copy-resources --no-open --no-prompt --force && npm run safari:prepare
scripts.safari:archive: xcodebuild -project safari/generated/ReviewMoa/ReviewMoa.xcodeproj -scheme ReviewMoa -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS -derivedDataPath safari/build/DerivedData -archivePath safari/build/ReviewMoa.xcarchive archive -allowProvisioningUpdates
scripts.release:gate: npm test && npm run worker:check && npm run collector:build
scripts.check: npm run release:gate && npm run build
